items.title: Cloud Topics Part 2: Considerations for 26.1 Private Link Users
items.author: Redpanda Data
items.summary:
Cloud Topics became Generally Available in the 26.1 release. Cloud Topics allow streaming customers to bypass expensive cross-availability-zone replication fees by writing payloads directly to inexpensive object storage (S3/GCS). You can expect 90% savings on data transfer costs. Hear current differences from other diskless options and considerations for 26.1 and Private Link users.

Links: 
- https://www.redpanda.com/blog/cloud-topics-metastore 
- https://www.redpanda.com/blog/adaptive-write-request-scheduling-in-redpandas-cloud-topics

items.title: Production Readiness with RPK Check
items.author: Redpanda Data
items.summary:
Use the rpk check command to quickly verify your cluster's health and operational status. It provides a point-in-time assessment of production readiness, helping you identify configuration issues and confirm that your deployment is using the features and best practices recommended for long-term success.

Links: https://docs.redpanda.com/streaming/current/deploy/redpanda/kubernetes/k-production-readiness/
